page.overview:
Who is Carateka?

Carateka, also referred to as Carate Headband, is a van that takes karate lessons at a karate dojo named Carate in Tokyo.

Carateka is painted white, with a black symbol on both of his doors. He wears a red and white headband, featuring the same symbol. The symbol in question is a car-ified version of the Seal of Tokyo.

In Cars 2, Carateka is coming out of a karate dojo alongside other vans while Finn McMissile fights the lemons that are trying to sabotage the first race of the World Grand Prix.
